task: oxide#081 probe whether a Cargo build directory survives an APFS clone to a new path

session.non_cargo_invocations: 2 rustc -vV toolchain inspections; 20 direct runs of already-built fixture binaries (bin + integration test per step); git archive | tar staging
session.writer_closure: every owned process group returned ESRCH after exit; no stop, kill or forced cleanup
session.scratch_removed_after_closure: root /private/tmp/oxide-clone-probe.mbj4vjda removed by ordinary rm -rf after the session; raw evidence copied first

pinned.nightly: nightly-2026-08-05 toolchain, rustc 1.99.0-nightly (1ed2df61a 2026-08-04); its cargo version was not separately queried
pinned.profile: default dev profile (debuginfo=2, split-debuginfo=unpacked, incremental), no RUSTFLAGS, no wrapper
pinned.layout: CARGO_BUILD_BUILD_DIR = buildA then buildB (the cloned slot); CARGO_TARGET_DIR = one unchanged private target dir, as the oxide front door injects them

verdicts.oxide-real (Oxide repository, stable): relocatable for Cargo freshness and rebuilds; debug maps of not-yet-relinked binaries still point at A

findings.clone_is_cow: clonefile(2) rc 0 on all three directories; every file got a new inode with equal size, mode and mtime_ns; F_LOG2PHYS_EXT first-extent device offsets equal for 294/294, 287/287 and 300/300 sampled files, while a plain read/write copy control got a different offset each time
findings.after_clone_unchanged: F2/O2 with A renamed away: every compiler artifact fresh (8/8, 8/8, 38/38), no Dirty line, no build-script run, binaries pass
findings.link_search_replay: Cargo rewrote the replayed rustc-link-search from A's OUT_DIR to B's (build-script-executed linked_paths) although B's cloned output/root-output files still name A; the source-only edit (F3) recompiled and linked libprobe_native.a from B with A absent
findings.rebuilds: source edit rebuilt exactly the edited package's units; build-input edit reran the build script and regenerated code; following no-op fresh; all expected values observed
findings.no_fingerprint_hits: no occurrence of A's path in any .fingerprint file in any arm
findings.remaining_original_paths: after the final step: rustc make-style .d files of unchanged units; root-output files of unchanged dependency build scripts; serde/serde_core rlib/rmeta source maps naming A's OUT_DIR private.rs; proc-macro dylib install names (LC_ID_DYLIB); N_OSO debug-map entries in proc-macro test binaries that were not relinked. Before relink (F2/O2) every binary, including target/debug/* final outputs, carried N_OSO entries naming A's deps/*.o. None changed Cargo or test behaviour here; debugger use of not-relinked binaries was not tested

oxide-real.note: st_blocks_allocated_bytes is the st_blocks*512 sum over every file and directory entry (the raw result.json key src_logical_allocated_bytes / logical_allocated_bytes is a recipe misnomer); it is allocated blocks, not apparent size, and does not see APFS clone sharing. Host free space is shared with other tasks and noisy; it is not an exact clone allocation or SSD-write figure. src file nlink=2 for 1762 files because the private target dir hard-links uplifted outputs; clones have nlink=1

recipe_corrections: build_script_runs in result.json matches only `build-script-build`; layout v2 names the binary `build_script_build`, so nightly F1 and F4 show 0 although raw stderr shows one run each. Nightly freshness above was re-read from raw stderr (F2/F5: 0 runs, 0 rustc, 0 Dirty).

The search classifier labels every file under build/<pkg>/<hash>/out/ as build-script-OUT_DIR-content; in layout v2 that directory also holds unit outputs (.rlib, .rmeta, .d, executables). Read the nightly hit file names, not the category.
Call wall_seconds are quantised by the 0.2 s poll loop; they are not timings of tiny commands.
not_claimed: No universal portability, debugger correctness, per-task savings, SSD-write or production-readiness claim; one fixture, one repository, one host, one volume.
